program='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    output = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]\n    seen = set()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            color = grid[r][c]\n            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:\n                continue\n            stack = [(r, c)]\n            seen.add((r, c))\n            component = []\n            while stack:\n                y, x = stack.pop()\n                component.append((y, x))\n                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):\n                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:\n                        seen.add((yy, xx))\n                        stack.append((yy, xx))\n            if len(component) >= 4:\n                top = min(y for y, _ in component)\n                bottom = max(y for y, _ in component)\n                left = min(x for _, x in component)\n                right = max(x for _, x in component)\n                for y in range(top, bottom + 1):\n                    for x in range(left, right + 1):\n                        output[y][x] = color\n    return output\n'''
